correctness.rationale: The backward marked-Poisson Gaussian variance-series has an L1 limit and unique finite-variance stationary law. Every truncated variance is affine in each independent U=A²; successive convex-order comparisons and L1 call-option continuity establish the infinite perpetuity order, and independent multiplication by Z² transfers to X². Two independent exact moment recursions and 365 finite checks corroborate the normalization; fourth moments give both unique sharp equality cases. The analytical proof is independent of finite tests.
